documented_probe: None. This is the second independent covering task for C-2d0e9195 (generate and protect a 2048-bit rsa private key); the reference task plum-seal touches key generation only as a sub-step of X.509 certificate issuance, while this task centers the full key-generation contract: exact bit-length policy, unencrypted PEM, explicit 0600 mode under any umask, overwrite semantics, and precise exit codes.
notes: Two-stage: build a reusable validating generator (policy gate on bit size with exit code 2, umask-independent chmod 0600, overwrite semantics) and then actually run it to leave the 2048-bit /app/deploy_key.pem. Hidden cases execute the script on accepted sizes (2048/3072/4096, incl. umask 000), rejected sizes/inputs (1024, 0, negative, non-numeric, 16384) that must exit 2 and create nothing, and an overwrite case. Medium: adversarial_inputs and unsafe_action_penalty (permissions are the core), quantitative_correctness (exact bit length and exit codes), one dependent stage (script then key), tool_breadth (openssl + shell + stat).
